scope: One additional 100-update story-only segment from the bound P67 checkpoint, plus the user's focus replay. Training language behavior only; not factual teaching or chat certification.
source_basis: P28 review of 64 examples approves a bounded noisy-fiction pilot. P54 reviewed the focus material and bound its source. This continuation separately acknowledges prior source use rather than treating each fork as new independent data.
limitations: Cumulative exposure includes 1,638,400 story targets in P34 and 847,656 in P67 before this continuation; targets may repeat.
Short continuation may hurt dialogue; compare to the parent and stop if it regresses.
Fiction and translation defects do not teach factual truth.
